reasons: The insertion is correctly placed as new Section 10.3 immediately after the existing effect-of-termination provisions (10.1 access cut-off, 10.2 Deliverables/refunds), which indeed contain no data-return, transition-assistance, or deletion obligation — supporting the 'missing' status.

The inserted language tracks the playbook preferred position closely: six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return/export of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter; the obligation runs against Vendor only, as intended.

Minor drafter additions are acceptable and not directionally adverse: extending the trigger to 'any Order Form' is customer-favorable, and the routine-backup/legal-retention carve-out to deletion is a standard practical qualifier that does not defeat the certification requirement.

Existing paragraphs 10.1 and 10.2 are left untouched — the smallest edit that reaches the position — and deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and the data-return/transition text is present.
The comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position, and offers the ninety-day fallback with the same thirty-day export, consistent with the fallback tier.
